contract: GET /api/backups/:id/apply is admin-only. It answers 200 after applying a listed archive, 404 for an unknown id, 403/401 for access, and validates absdatabase.sqlite before replacing the database; a listed archive without it answers 500 before any swap, and metadata entries are extracted under metadata/items and metadata/authors without creating symlinks.
exceptions: State scenarios are not applicable: this record treats apply as a request/validation contract; the runtime swap and backup_applied are owned by cap-flow-backup-restore-swap and cap-event-backup-applied.

Applying an archive whose absdatabase.sqlite is not a readable SQLite database is not asserted: upstream v2.37.2 swaps it in, Database.reconnect rejects with SQLITE_NOTADB and the process exits 1. The live server wins over the intended rejection; the corruption gap is reported as an open question.
Named Go tests remain assertion leads for the Go implementation; the scenario refs are the black-box proof.

invariants.contract: GET /api/backups/:id/apply answers 200 for a listed archive and keeps it listed with the install readable; an ordinary user gets 403, an anonymous caller 401 and an unknown id 404, with no list, file or install change.
exceptions: Named tests listed are relevant package-level current tests; their assertions do not yet prove every route branch or the complete upstream contract.

invariants.contract: Apply validates the archive before the swap: an archive without absdatabase.sqlite is rejected with 500 before Database.disconnect, a valid archive extracts its metadata-items tree under metadata/items, and a symlink entry is stored as a regular file, never as a link.
